read: Broad AI-hardware/semis gap-and-hold (MU +10% at 95% of range, LITE, MRVL, INTC, HPE, ORCL +6-11%, QQQ +1.7%) against software/services weakness (MSFT -2.0% at day low on 2.3x vol, ACN, CTSH, INTU, ADSK) and soft staples/healthcare; SPY flat since the open. Web search found no dated primary-source catalyst for MU's move or MSFT's slide today, and the only single-name catalyst in the headlines (Jefferies' GLW initiation, 09:15) was already in the 6.9% gap and has faded 1% since the open. Chasing MU at the top of its range or fading MSFT without a named reason is a price pattern, which the desk has already failed 15 times, so: no trade. Morning book check: CI short working (-2.4% since open), AMGN, NVDA and COST roughly flat to slightly against since the open. Spike pod quiet, nothing to flag.
